newsitem.title: USA: Noland Q1 sales rise 4.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Noland Q1 sales rise 4.4 percent.

text.p: Noland Co said on Tuesday its March sales were $37.9 million, up 1.9 percent from $37.2 million for the same month in 1996.
First quarter sales were $110.9 million, up 4.4 percent from $106.2 million for the same period a year ago.

Noland distributes products for plumbing, heating, electrical, air conditioning, refrigeration and industrial uses, as well as water well systems. Its stock was trading at 21-1/2 late Tuesday, unchanged on the day.
